description: A grant that a lead gives to open one area for an agent. Generated from the reference.

actions.description: The actions that the override allows. Only `read` and `write` have an effect.

agent_session_id.description: If present, the override applies only to this agent session.

area.description: The name of the area that the override opens.

expires_at.description: If present, the override is inactive from this time on. A value that is not a timestamp in the form that the policy contract defines makes the override inactive.

mission_id.description: If present, the override applies only to this mission.

title: Override
